headline: Approved raising snow emergency parking fines from $25 to $50; dozens of older traffic requests remain tabled.
summary: The commission accepted the January 20, 2026 minutes and approved increasing fines for illegal parking during a snow emergency from $25.00 to $50.00. Many older agenda items, including speed humps, stop signs, bus stop changes, and crosswalk requests across multiple streets, remained tabled pending further study or information.
decisions: Approved increasing the fine for illegal parking during a snow emergency from $25.00 to $50.00.

decision_evidence.quote: a motion was made by Mr. Dick Barricelli, seconded by Chief Steven Froio and unanimously voice voted to approve increasing the fines for illegal parking during a snow emergency.
